name: Socioh
description_en:
Socioh is the legacy brand of a catalog-ad creative and product-feed service now presented as goodAds.ai. The assigned Socioh site explicitly announces that rebrand. The current offer combines feed preparation, branded Dynamic Product Ads and Product Level Videos with design support and creative testing. It should be evaluated as an ecommerce advertising-production workflow, rather than inferred to be a general organic-post scheduler from its directory category.

The useful decision is how much catalog production the retailer wants to own. The current pricing page separates a waitlisted self-serve route from a White Glove service, while older Socioh guides describe direct template and product selection. A brand team can evaluate its ability to review creative and supply reliable product data; a growth team can evaluate feeds and a controlled test against existing ads. No store, ad account, billing flow or campaign was operated, and vendor conversion claims are not independent results.
description_zh:
Socioh 是目录广告创意与商品 feed 服务的旧品牌，现以 goodAds.ai 展示；所分配 Socioh 原站明确公告更名。现行服务结合 feed 准备、品牌化 Dynamic Product Ads、Product Level Videos、设计支持及创意测试。应按电商广告生产流程评估，不能仅因目录分类推成通用自然社交帖排程器。

有用的决策是零售商希望自行承担多少目录生产。当前价格页区分候补自助路线与 White Glove 服务，较旧 Socioh 指南则描述直接选择模板及商品。品牌团队可评估创意审核与可靠商品数据准备，增长团队可评估 feed 及与已有广告的可控测试。未操作商店、广告账户、账单或活动，供应商转化主张不构成独立效果结果。

core_features.explanation_zh: SLA 区分 feed 可达性与创意生产周期。

en: Commission branded catalog creative from a reliable ecommerce feed.
Map sale messaging across products and review representative edge cases.
Compare catalog creative variants with an agreed paid-ad baseline.
zh: 从可靠电商 feed 委托品牌目录创意。
跨商品映射促销信息并审代表性边缘情况。
按约定付费广告基线比较目录创意变体。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current goodAds.ai Meta Only view: Self-serve $1,000/month (Waitlist), White Glove $2,500/month; 25K SKUs included and $250 per additional 25K, twenty live designs. Terms specify USD unless stated otherwise, excluding applicable tax. Ad-platform spend is separate. All Channels rates not verified. Legacy Socioh revenue tiers show $1,100/$2,100/$3,500 and Enterprise from $5,000, but another line says $2,500. The old pricing FAQ denies a free trial despite free signup language; no sustained free production established. Current/legacy conflict prevents a normalized price or universal refund claim.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前 goodAds.ai Meta Only：自助 $1,000／月（候补），White Glove $2,500／月；含 25K SKU，每增加 25K 为 $250，二十个在线设计。条款说明除另述外为 USD，未含适用税；广告平台花费独立。All Channels 费率未核。旧 Socioh 收入档列 $1,100／$2,100／$3,500、Enterprise 自 $5,000，另一行又为 $2,500。旧价格 FAQ 否认免费试用但保留免费注册文字，未确定持续免费生产。新旧冲突不分配标准化价格或通用退款主张。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: The current workflow includes people as well as software
sections.title_zh: 现行流程包含人员服务及软件
sections.en: The current service FAQ starts with a creative brief, five to seven concepts and iteration with the brand. Feed checks and production precede the first catalog ad; two weeks is a stated typical onboarding expectation, not a measured guarantee. The vendor supports strategy, setup, testing and reporting but explicitly does not run the customer’s ads. Editorial evaluation: agree on the creative approver, feed owner and campaign operator, and request representative edge cases before commissioning a complete feed. A designed catalog and an ad campaign remain separate deliverables.
sections.zh: 现行服务 FAQ 从创意简报、五至七个概念及品牌迭代开始。Feed 检查及生产先于首个目录广告；两周是其典型入驻预期，不是已测保证。供应商支持策略、设置、测试及报告，但明确不代客户运行广告。编辑评估：约定创意批准者、feed 负责人及活动操作者，制作完整 feed 前要求代表性边缘样例；已设计目录与广告活动仍是独立交付。

sections.title_en: The older creation guide separates products, design and Publish
sections.title_zh: 较旧创建指南区分商品、设计与 Publish
sections.en: The July 2024 Socioh guide selects a template, then all products, collections or individual products. Custom designs appear in My Templates. Review and Save permits template-variation edits or individual creative adjustments; Publish then leads to ad setup. These are documented legacy steps, not a verified screenshot of today’s goodAds.ai application. Editorial merchandising example: select the intended sale collection, inspect several different image shapes and confirm the correct product set before making the catalog available. Saving a reusable template is not evidence that every product is eligible or that an ad has begun spending.
sections.zh: 2024 年 7 月 Socioh 指南先选模板，再选全部商品、集合或单品。定制设计在 My Templates，Review and Save 可改模板变体或单个创意，Publish 后再设广告。这是旧文档步骤，不是已核今日 goodAds.ai 应用截图。编辑促销示例：选准确促销集合，检查不同图片形状，供给目录前核正确商品集。保存复用模板不能证明全部商品合格或广告已开始花费。

sections.title_en: A rule must be checked on products that do not match it
sections.title_zh: 规则也要检查不命中的商品
sections.en: The dated Master Template guide describes one or several variations. Automation maps a product value into a selected element; Visibility Rules decide whether that element appears, for example only showing a discount above a threshold. The saved design can be named for reuse. Editorial catalog check: compare an eligible sale item, an item below the threshold and an item with missing source data. Keep the source field and display rule explicit; a visually correct first card does not establish correctness across variants, categories or the entire feed. Current application behavior and fallback handling were not tested.
sections.zh: 有日期 Master Template 指南描述单个或多个变体。Automation 将商品值映射到选中元素，Visibility Rules 决定是否显示，例如折扣超过阈值才显示。保存设计可命名复用。编辑目录检查：比较符合折扣项、低于阈值项及缺源数据项，明确源字段及显示规则；首卡视觉正确不代表变体、类别或全 feed 都正确。未测试现行应用行为及回退处理。

sections.title_en: Missing products and a low match rate are different failures
sections.title_zh: 缺商品与匹配率低是不同失败
sections.en: A June 2024 Shopify troubleshooting article says an unsubscribed signup initially imports only 500 products and subscribed imports include Active products. This does not establish a current free production allowance. A separate guide diagnoses low catalog match through mismatched pixel Content ID versus catalog Item Group ID, a different connected pixel, or an incomplete catalog. Editorial investigation: first confirm the expected product set and source status, then compare event and catalog identifiers for a concrete item. Rebuilding designs cannot by itself repair an identifier or source-availability mismatch; no live event/attribution test was performed.
sections.zh: 2024 年 6 月 Shopify 故障文说未订阅注册初导仅 500 商品，订阅后导入 Active 商品，不能据此确定当前免费生产额度。另一指南从 pixel Content ID 与目录 Item Group ID 不匹配、连接不同 pixel 或目录不完整排查低匹配率。编辑调查：先核预期商品集及源状态，再以具体商品比较事件与目录标识。重建设计本身不能修复标识或源可用性不匹配，未执行真实事件／归因测试。

sections.title_en: Feed refresh and ad-platform propagation have different clocks
sections.title_zh: Feed 刷新与广告平台传播有不同时钟
sections.en: The old Socioh sync guide describes a few-minute Meta update after a catalog edit. The current SLA instead describes production feed refreshes every 24 hours, or 36–48 hours above 50K SKUs. These statements cover different stages and cannot be combined into instant end-to-end updating. The SLA separately gives 99.9% monthly platform/feed availability, excludes upstream platform/source-data problems and treats production turnaround as throughput. Its business-hour response targets differ from the FAQ’s broad 24/7 support wording. Editorial launch check: agree on refresh and campaign deadlines, inspect the exported feed and native fetch state, and use the actual service agreement for escalation.
sections.zh: 旧 Socioh 同步指南描述目录编辑后 Meta 几分钟更新；当前 SLA 则描述生产 feed 每 24 小时刷新，超过 50K SKU 为 36–48 小时。这些针对不同阶段，不能合并成端到端即时更新。SLA 另给平台／feed 月可用 99.9%，排除上游平台／源数据问题，生产周期按吞吐处理。其工作时间响应目标不同于 FAQ 广义 24/7 支持。编辑上线检查：约定刷新及活动期限，查导出 feed 与原生抓取状态，升级处理以真实服务约定为据。

sections.title_en: Test a message against a defined baseline
sections.title_zh: 对明确定义基线测试信息
sections.en: The current site advertises parallel testing of up to twenty creative variations against an existing catalog ad. Its process includes feed audit, manual product checks and feedback through a dedicated collaboration channel. These describe a service method, not proof of incrementality or guaranteed preservation of every platform learning state. Editorial experiment: agree on the baseline catalog, audience, spend, dates and decision metric before comparing variants; retain feed/design versions so a sale or stock change is not mistaken for a creative effect. Public customer logos and lift figures are not measurements made in this research.
sections.zh: 现行网站宣传最多二十个创意变体与已有目录广告并行测试，流程含 feed 审查、商品人工检查及专用协作渠道反馈。这描述服务方法，不能证明增量效果或所有平台学习状态都保证保留。编辑实验：比较前约定基线目录、受众、花费、日期及决策指标，保留 feed／设计版本，避免将促销或库存变化误作创意效果。公开客户标识及提升数字不是本研究测量。

sections.title_en: Current packages differ from the Socioh revenue tiers
sections.title_zh: 现行套餐不同于 Socioh 收入分档
sections.en: The goodAds.ai Meta Only table separates a waitlisted self-serve route from White Glove. Its common allowance includes 25K SKUs with paid increments and twenty live designs; the service levels differ in templates and production support. All Channels is a separate selector whose exact prices were not established. The legacy Socioh page instead tiers by online revenue and contradicts itself on Enterprise starting price. Editorial procurement: obtain a current scope covering channel, SKU count, dimensions and who handles production. Do not assume legacy unlimited/all-inclusive language overrides a current metered package or that waitlist access is immediate.
sections.zh: goodAds.ai 的 Meta Only 表区分候补自助与 White Glove，共同额度含 25K SKU、付费增量及二十个在线设计，模板及生产支持因服务级别不同。All Channels 为独立选项，其准确费率未确定。旧 Socioh 页按线上收入分档，Enterprise 起价自相矛盾。编辑采购：获取当前渠道、SKU 数、尺寸及生产责任范围，不能以旧不限／全包措辞覆盖当前计量套餐，也不能把候补当即时可用。

sections.title_en: Approval, training use and cancellation need their own review
sections.title_zh: 批准、训练用途及取消需各自审核
sections.en: Current terms require customers to review output and follow ad-platform rules; they do not guarantee ad approval or performance. They provide broad input/output training rights unless a written enterprise agreement limits them. A service-plan portfolio clause also covers unused creative. Cancellation is through settings or written notice and takes effect at the billing-period end; prepaid fees are generally non-refundable. This differs from the older Socioh FAQ’s first-time 30-day guarantee. Editorial handoff: settle rights and any confidential-launch restrictions in the actual order, and obtain final assets before access ends. This summarizes published vendor terms without determining enforceability.
sections.zh: 当前条款要求客户审输出并遵守广告平台规则，不保证广告批准或效果。除非书面企业约定限制，输入／输出训练权范围较广，服务档作品集条款还含未使用创意。通过设置或书面通知取消，在计费期末生效，预付款通常不退；不同于旧 Socioh FAQ 首次三十天保证。编辑交接：在真实订单落实权利及保密上线限制，访问结束前取得最终素材。此为公开供应商条款摘要，不判断法律效力。

sections.title_en: Cancellation does not establish a universal deletion deadline
sections.title_zh: 取消不确定普遍删除期限
sections.en: The current retention policy describes written, authenticated deletion requests, contractual timelines and a possible agreed one-time export. Active-service, legal and backup needs can affect deletion. It supplies no universal number of days for every catalog or backup; terms also retain specified post-termination uses. Editorial exit plan: request the required feed/assets and agree on export format, timing and deletion scope before closing access. Disconnecting an ad platform, ending billing and deleting stored or training-related data should be checked as distinct outcomes. No export, deletion or account action was executed.
sections.zh: 当前保留政策描述书面实名核验删除请求、合同时间线及可约定的一次导出。活动服务、法律及备份需求可影响删除；未给全部目录／备份普遍天数，条款也保留部分终止后用途。编辑退出计划：关闭访问前请求所需 feed／素材，约定导出格式、时间及删除范围。断广告平台、结束账单、删除存储或训练相关数据需分别核结果，未执行导出、删除或账户动作。

seo.title_zh: Socioh／goodAds.ai：品牌目录生产及 feed 检查

seo.description_zh: 评估 Socioh 更名、目录映射、feed 恢复、托管创意流程、服务承诺及当前价格边界。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Socioh and goodAds.ai catalog creative production
